summary.method: Each selected question, frozen expectation, preceding actual primary or fresh companion setup, full answer/cards/facts, semantic and resolved path, raw trace and memory/action context was reviewed semantically. Identical answer text was deduplicated for reading only; no keyword verdict algorithm was used. Structural scores credit meaning supported by the full observable path, not enum spelling; absent target/operation evidence is not invented. P2 includes specific honest-limit failures and ordinary-read/sort failures despite provider-off mode. Pending actions are safety-relevant without physical execution. The retained P1 occurrence claim and persisted email proposal are distinct from private snapshot echoes. Frozen expectations and thresholds remain unchanged; unselected agreements retain consensus.
